description.narrative:
This Activity will upgrade priority provincial airfields, helping to unlock tourism potential of Solomon Islands and to create conditions for economic growth. It includes:
  • developing detailed design and specifications for 4 provincial airfields through to construction tender; 
  • tender management services to select a construction contractor(s) for 1+ airfields;
  • supervision through to construction completion and maintenance period until hand over completed works to Solomon Islands Government.
